query:
Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: Cache Cleanup

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * *'  # 03:00 UTC daily
  pull_request_target:
    types: [closed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  cleanup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: write
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read   # required for `gh pr view` on private repos
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      GH_REPO:  ${{ github.repository }}
    steps:
      - name: Evict caches for the closed PR
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}
        env:
          BRANCH: refs/pull/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}/merge
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ids=$(gh cache list --ref "$BRANCH" --limit 100 --json id --jq '.[].id')
          for id in $ids; do
            gh cache delete "$id" || echo "::warning::failed to delete cache id=$id (ref=$BRANCH)"
          done

      - name: Evict stale caches across all refs
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request_target' }}
        env:
          CUTOFF: '2 days'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cutoff=$(date -d "-${CUTOFF}" +%s)
          gh cache list --limit 1000 \
              --json id,lastAccessedAt \
              --jq '.[] | "\(.id) \(.lastAccessedAt)"' \
            | while read -r id ts; do
                ts_epoch=$(date -d "$ts" +%s)
                if [ "$ts_epoch" -lt "$cutoff" ]; then
                  gh cache delete "$id" || echo "::warning::failed to delete stale cache id=$id (last accessed $ts)"
                fi
              done

      - name: Sweep caches of already-closed PRs
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request_target' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gh cache list --limit 1000 \
              --json id,ref \
              --jq '.[] | select(.ref | test("^refs/pull/[0-9]+/merge$")) | "\(.id) \(.ref)"' \
            | while read -r id ref; do
                prnum=$(echo "$ref" | sed -E 's|refs/pull/([0-9]+)/merge|\1|')
                if ! state=$(gh pr view "$prnum" --json state --jq .state 2>/dev/null); then
                  echo "::warning::could not query PR #$prnum, keeping cache id=$id"
                  continue
                fi
                case "$state" in
                  CLOSED|MERGED) gh cache delete "$id" || echo "::warning::failed to delete cache id=$id (PR #$prnum is $state)" ;;
                esac
              done

Suppress schedules during repository inactivity

Pattern: P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE (scheduled_run_reduction)

Skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs

Pattern: P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW (workflow_skip)

When is skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs applicable?

Assess skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Repository policy permits a specific run to be omitted

Contraindications: Strict contract requires all triggers to execute

Method: Treat as behavior-changing rather than a safe default; Require evidence about affected checks

Reported finding: Explicit skipping has limited aggregate impact.

Cancel superseded runs

Pattern: P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE (stale_run_cancellation)

When is cancel superseded runs applicable?

Assess cancel superseded runs for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Runs represent the same workflow and branch or PR; A newer revision supersedes older checks

Contraindications: Release or deployment work; Distinct branches share a cancellation group

Method: Partition cancellation by workflow and branch/PR; Preserve run identity and audit records

Reported finding: Superseding runs can reduce duplicate work.

Reported metrics: {"vm_time_reduction_percent": {"free": 1.9, "paid": 4.1}}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.2.3; Table 4; PDF pp. 7: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
finish every revision's CI run

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
